audience: online sellers who manage orders and stock across channels in Sello

useCases.title: Review today's orders
useCases.text: List the orders with their rows and deliveries and open one to read the history.

useCases.title: Check the sales numbers
useCases.text: Read the stats summary, the daily and monthly turnover and the top sellers.

useCases.title: Check the stock worth
useCases.text: Read the total stock worth and the products with their change history.

useCases.title: Update the stock of a product
useCases.text: Set a new stock quantity for a product after a delivery.

useCases.title: Update the status of an order
useCases.text: Change an order, for example its status or a comment, when it ships.

useCases.title: Check unread messages and errors
useCases.text: Count the unread messages and read the latest ones. They include synchronization errors and warnings from your sales channels.
